These complete length-prefixed protocol frames are checked against actual Unix socket writes from Rust production adapters. Workload identity: terrabase/src/backup/workload_identity_delivery.rs::tests::runtime_producer_matches_broker_golden. Customer KMS: terrabase/src/encryption/customer_key_delivery.rs::tests::runtime_producer_matches_broker_golden_with_omitted_endpoint and terrabase/crates/terrabase-server/src/production_data_runtime.rs::lifecycle_tests::production_customer_kms_none_endpoint_matches_broker_golden. Go keylease/workload_wire_contract_test.go consumes identical hex files through the live broker. Keep each corresponding file byte-identical across repositories; changing a frame requires both producer and consumer tests.
